name: Spore-Mother

Traits.name: Anchored Dead
Traits.text: When a creature dies within 10 feet of the spore-mother, The corpse is threaded and rises as a spore-puppet that acts on the spore-mother's turn, moving toward the nearest living creature and clawing at it; the spore-mother can command up to such puppets at once, and each collapses when she is destroyed.
Traits.clause: Every corpse that falls near the spore-mother is already threaded: when a creature dies within reach of her mycelium, pa
Traits.expresses: seizing and reanimating the bodies of the slain
Traits.expressedQuote: When a creature dies within 10 feet of the spore-mother, The corpse is threaded and rises as a spore-puppet that acts on the spore-mother's turn, moving toward the nearest living creature and clawing at it

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the spore-mother, the spore-mother and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the spore-mother doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The spore-mother makes three Spore Lash attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Corpse Puppet.

Actions.name: Spore Lash
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Corpse Puppet
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 15 feet straight toward the spore-mother, and its Speed is 0 until the start of the spore-mother's next turn.
Actions.gmQuote: takes over the bodies of the things she kills and sends them at you

lore: The last fruiting body of a forest that died screaming, it walks only because its old host is fertilizer for the next one.
